The design is close: gain is 59.5 dB against the 51 dB spec, and GBW is 35.8 MHz against 26 MHz. The -3 dB bandwidth is the only failure, at 37.7 kHz against 66 kHz. Since f3db ≈ GBW/A, I'll lower gain on purpose. At A ≤ 54 dB (about 500×), f3db is roughly 70 kHz or more. The quickest lever for that is a shorter PMOS mirror L.

```json
{"action": "refine",
 "reason": "Topology fine; only f3db fails because gain (59.5 dB) is too high for the GBW. Shorten PMOS mirror L to drop gain to ~53-54 dB, raising f3db = GBW/A above 66 kHz while keeping gain >51 dB and GBW margin.",
 "params": {"Lp": 0.8, "Itail": 22e-6, "gmid1": 15.0},
 "bounds": {"Lp": [0.35, 2.0], "Itail": [14e-6, 26e-6]}}
```
